opportunities.name: City weekend trip planner (research, hotel, activities, dinner, notes, email draft)
opportunities.description: For a given city and weekend dates, gather Wikipedia population, weather, a Booking hotel, Viator activities and an OpenTable dinner, then write the summary to Notes and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for the population
Search the city on timeanddate and open the weather page for the temperature
On Booking enter the destination, check-in/check-out dates and guests, then Search
Open a hotel result and its Info & prices tab for the price
On Viator search for an activity in the city and open a result, repeat for a second activity
On OpenTable search a cuisine in the city, pick the date and Let's go, open the top restaurant
Add a Notes entry summarising city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities and dinner
Open a new mail, fill To, Subject and Body with the plan, then Discard or Send

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults, Thames boat and Tower of London, London Indian dinner, maya@example.com
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 3 then 2 adults, whisky tasting and Highlands day trip, Edinburgh Scottish dinner, priya@example.com (Dublin was explored along the way and abandoned)

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a destination with check-in/out dates and guest count, then open the top hotel's Info & prices page.
steps: Clear or click the destination field and type the city
Select the suggested option
Open the date picker and select check-in and check-out dates
Adjust adults in the occupancy popup and click Done
Click Search
Open a hotel result and its Info & prices tab

opportunities.name: Viator activity search and open top result
opportunities.description: Search Viator for an activity query and open the first result.
steps: Click the search box and clear existing text
Type the activity query
Click Search for the query option
Open the first result

opportunities.name: Wikipedia then timeanddate city lookup
opportunities.description: Look up a city on Wikipedia and then its current weather on timeanddate.
steps: Type the city into Wikipedia search and open the article
Type the city into the timeanddate search and open the result
Open the weather page

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by cuisine and date
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for a cuisine/location on a given date and open the top restaurant.
steps: Click the search box and type the query
Open the date selector, navigate months and choose the date
Click Let's go / Find a table
Open the first restaurant

opportunities.name: Save trip summary note and draft email
opportunities.description: Add a trip summary note, then compose an email to a friend with the plan and discard it.
steps: Type the summary into the New note box and press Enter
Open New message
Fill To, Subject and Body
Click Discard
